info.name: ATW Backend - Admin API
info.description:
Admin authentication, account self-service, and permission-catalog endpoints for the Anytime Work backend. Every response is wrapped in the standard envelope: {"success": boolean, "data": <payload|null>, "error": <ApiError|null>}. See FRONTEND_HANDOVER.md in the repo for the full error-code reference and the auth flow explanation.

Requests that save tokens use a Tests script to populate the environment's accessToken/refreshToken/challengeId variables automatically — run them in order (Login -> Verify OTP -> ...) with the ATW Backend - Local environment selected.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Public endpoints under /api/admin/auth/** - no bearer token required.

request.description: Verifies the password. If OTP is enabled (the default), returns {otpRequired: true, challengeId}; the OTP is emailed (or, with MAIL_PROVIDER=log, printed to the server log) - copy it into the Verify OTP request below. If OTP is disabled, returns {otpRequired: false, tokens} directly - same shape as Verify OTP's response.

exec: console.log('OTP required - challengeId saved. Check the server log (or your inbox) for the code, then run Verify OTP.');

request.description: Submits the 6-digit code for the challenge from Login. On success returns the full AuthTokens payload (accessToken, refreshToken, admin profile). Wrong code: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. 6th wrong attempt in a row: 422 BUSINESS_RULE_VIOLATION ("Too many invalid attempts") even if you then submit the right code - request a new OTP via Resend or Login again.

Issues a fresh code and INVALIDATES the previous one (the old challengeId stops working the moment this succeeds). Returns a new challengeId - this request's Tests script overwrites the saved one. Subject to a cooldown (default 60s) and a cap on total resends per login attempt (default 3) - both return 422 BUSINESS_RULE_VIOLATION.

Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access+refresh pair, revoking the old refresh token (rotation - it cannot be reused after this). Call this when a protected request gets a 401 UNAUTHENTICATED because the access token (15 min default lifetime) expired. If the refresh token itself is expired/revoked, this also 401s - the user must log in again.

Revokes the given refresh token. Always returns success (idempotent) even if the token was already invalid. The frontend should also discard the access token client-side immediately - it stays technically valid until it naturally expires (max 15 min).

Always returns success, whether or not the email belongs to an admin (prevents account enumeration - do not treat this response as confirmation the email exists). If it does, a reset link is emailed (or logged, with MAIL_PROVIDER=log) as {{atw.frontend.base-url}}/admin/reset-password?token=<token> - the frontend route should read that token param and POST it to Reset Password below.

Sets a new password from a reset-link token (30 min TTL by default). On success this ALSO: revokes every refresh token and access-token session for that admin, invalidates every other outstanding reset link and pending login-OTP for that admin, and sends a "your password was changed" email. newPassword must be 8-100 characters.

item.name: Account
item.description: Authenticated self-service for the signed-in admin, under /api/admin/account/**. Requires Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}.

request.description: Returns the signed-in admin's profile: id, username, email, fullName, superAdmin, roles, authorities, mustChangePassword. The frontend should check mustChangePassword right after login/verify-otp and, if true, redirect straight to a change-password screen - every OTHER endpoint will reject with 403 MUST_CHANGE_PASSWORD until it's changed (this endpoint and change-password are the only two exceptions).

Returns the effective permission codes for the signed-in admin, e.g. ["staff.view", "roles.view", ...]. A super-admin gets ["*"] (wildcard - has every permission; the frontend should treat "*" as all-access rather than trying to match it literally against a known code list).

Requires the current password. On success: revokes every other session (refresh + access tokens) for this admin on every device, invalidates any outstanding forgot-password reset link and pending login-OTP, and clears mustChangePassword. The CURRENT request's access token also stops working immediately after this - the frontend must log the user back in (or silently re-authenticate) right after a successful change.

item.name: Admin
item.description: Permission-gated admin endpoints. Requires Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}} AND the named permission (or super-admin).

request.description: Requires the roles.view permission. Returns the full permission catalog grouped by module - [{module, permissions: [{code, action, label}]}] - for building a role editor matrix. Lacking the permission: 403 ACCESS_DENIED.
Returns {"status":"UP"} when healthy. Component detail (db, redis, mail) only shows for authenticated/authorized callers.
